description: Project scaffolding: pnpm workspace monorepo, TypeScript config, CDK app shell, shared types package, linting, and build tooling
steps: Initialize pnpm workspace at repo root with pnpm-workspace.yaml listing packages: packages/*, infra, lambdas/*
Create root package.json with workspace scripts: build, test, lint, format. Use vitest for testing, eslint + prettier for linting.
Create root tsconfig.json with strict mode, ES2022 target, Node22 module resolution. Create tsconfig.build.json extending it.

Create packages/shared-types/ package with TypeScript interfaces from the design doc: VideoRenderer port (plan/renderChunk/assemble), RenderInput, RenderPlan, ChunkResult, RenderOutput, VideoManifest (schemaVersion, deckId, deckVersion, locale, voice, outputs, captions, slides array with all fields from section 9), Project, Version, Job state types, API request/response types

Create packages/core/ package for shared business logic: S3 key builders following the S3 structure from section 16 ({productSlug}-{purpose}-{env}-{accountId}-{region}/{userId}/{projectId}/versions/v{NNNN}/...), duration calculation (measuredAudioMs + leadInMs + leadOutMs = durationMs, cumulative startMs), idempotency utilities
Create infra/ directory with CDK app entry point (bin/app.ts) and a placeholder main stack. Use productSlug from CDK context. Configure cdk.json with context defaults.
Create lambdas/ directory structure with placeholder directories: lambdas/marp-render/, lambdas/polly-worker/, lambdas/composition-builder/, lambdas/api/
Create config/ directory with parameter.ts for environment-specific config (dev/stg/prd) including productSlug, AWS region, model IDs, voice settings
Add .gitignore, .nvmrc (22), and a root README.md referencing the design document
Verify: run pnpm install, pnpm build, pnpm lint, pnpm test (no tests yet but should not error)
acceptance_criteria: pnpm install succeeds with no errors
pnpm build compiles all TypeScript packages without errors
pnpm lint runs without errors on the scaffolded code
packages/shared-types exports VideoRenderer interface with plan/renderChunk/assemble methods
packages/shared-types exports VideoManifest type matching section 9 of design doc
packages/core exports S3 key builder functions
infra/bin/app.ts reads productSlug from CDK context
config/parameter.ts exports environment configs for dev/stg/prd
verification: Run pnpm install && pnpm build && pnpm lint to confirm compilation and linting pass
findings: Node.js 22.23.2 and pnpm 10.28.1 confirmed available. NODE_OPTIONS env var causes a proxy-bootstrap error in sandbox - must unset before running pnpm/node commands. esbuild build scripts are ignored by pnpm (warning only, does not block). aws-cdk-lib 2.189.0 installs successfully. All 22 unit tests pass (s3-keys, duration, idempotency). ESLint 9 flat config works with typescript-eslint 8.33.0.
